recon.landing.subtitle: Recent scans across every project. Start new scans from a target's page.
recon.landing.helpSummary: Recon is reconnaissance: automatically mapping out a target's attack surface — subdomains, live hosts, crawled URLs, historical URLs, WHOIS/ASN ownership — before you look for vulnerabilities. Every scan runs against a target you've already added to a project.
recon.landing.step1: Open a project, then a target, and click "New scan" to pick a tool (subdomain enumeration, crawler, URL history, WHOIS, ASN lookup) and run it.
recon.landing.step2: Watch progress and live logs while the scan runs.
recon.landing.step3: Review the normalized findings (subdomains, URLs, hosts) — they feed into Vulnerabilities and the Asset Graph automatically.
recon.landing.actionScansDescription: Every recon job across all your projects, newest first — click one to see its live logs and results.
recon.landing.actionTargetDescription: Jumps to the target page a given scan ran against, where you can start more scans.
recon.landing.emptyDescription: Start a scan from any target's page to see it here.
recon.list.emptyDescription: Start a scan to see recon jobs here.

recon.log.finished: No live output for a finished job.
recon.findings.emptyDescription: Findings appear here as tools complete — domains, ports, technologies, and more.
recon.create.title: Start a recon scan
recon.create.description: Choose which tools to run against this target. Every scan runs asynchronously — you can close this dialog and track progress from the job list.
recon.create.error: Couldn't start the recon job. Please try again.

vuln.dashboard.subtitle: Findings and scan activity across every project. Start new scans from a target's page.
vuln.dashboard.recentEmpty: Findings will appear here as scans complete.
vuln.help.summary: This is where actual weaknesses are found and tracked — different from Recon (which only maps out what exists). Vulnerability scans test the targets and URLs Recon discovered for real security issues, and every result lands here as a finding with a severity rating.
vuln.help.step1: Pick a scanner under "Scanners" and a target to test, or apply a saved template under "Templates" to run several checks at once.
vuln.help.step2: Track progress under "Scan jobs" while it runs.
vuln.help.step3: Triage results here or under "Findings" — confirm real issues, mark false positives, and hand confirmed ones to Bug Bounty or Reports.
vuln.help.scanJobsDesc: Every vulnerability scan run across your projects — status, progress, and logs.
vuln.help.templatesDesc: Reusable bundles of scanner configs so you don't set up the same checks every time.
vuln.help.scannersDesc: Which scanning tools are available and their current status.
vuln.help.findingsDesc: A quick read on what's Critical/High right now, and the newest results to triage first.
